intended_application: Extract renewal and termination terms from supplier contracts with analyst review
business_need: Require at least 95% source-supported term extraction before operational use
capabilities_constraints: Hosted processing permitted in the approved test workspace; incumbent manual clause review; requires versioned document ingestion and page-level citations
risk_consequence_context: Missed terms can lead to unintended renewal or lost termination rights
management_question: Should management authorize a supervised pilot, and what would justify changing course?
additional_context:
